item.title: Cut diagnose command and inline notification wrappers
item.intent: Delete cmd-diagnose.sh module and diagnose dispatch entry. Replace send_notification wrapper with direct conditional at call sites. Simplify send_session_notification to terminal bell plus log message only.
steps: Remove diagnose dispatch entry from main()
Inline send_notification: at each call site replace with direct if-NOTIFY_CMD-then-run check
Simplify send_session_notification: remove macOS osascript and Linux notify-send branches, keep terminal bell plus log
Update help text to remove diagnose
Run smoke test and drift check
acceptanceCriteria: aishore diagnose produces unknown command error
